name: Why do bathroom door frames frequently stick or misalign in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Why do bathroom door frames frequently stick or misalign in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro area, seasonal shifts between dry winters and humid indoor bathroom air accelerate wood expansion, joint cracking, and settling misalignments. Older properties in Denver or Greenwood Village often experience foundation movement that twists door openings out of square, while newer builds in Parker or Centennial may have tighter moisture barriers that trap steam. When repairing frames locally, professionals check both the indoor humidity ventilation and the framing plumb to ensure the door latches properly throughout dry winter cold snaps and summer weather.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver's dry climate mixed with intense bathroom humidity causes wood to swell and contract rapidly, while local soil expansion can shift door openings out of square.
